machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.

thread_env.note: Not pinned (legacy variant): recorded as found.

note: Every row is a KERNEL measured in this cell's own process on the S3 system rebuilt at that draw's mass — never a library figure_of_merit, and never to be summed with one. `d_log_l` is measured on S0. A draw with `passes_to_certification: null` never certified inside `pass_budget_max` and counts as a fallback at EVERY budget.
